newsitem.title: USA: Air France tops capacity in 96 Europe-Asia air freight.
newsitem.headline: Air France tops capacity in 96 Europe-Asia air freight.

text.p: Air France displaced Deutsche Lufthansa AG as the capacity leader among scheduled carriers in the Europe-Asia air freight market in 1996, according to statistics compiled by the MergeGlobal, Inc cargo consultancy.
Air France led in total capacity of 244 million kgs, followed by Lufthansa with 238 million kgs.
MergeGlobal said Air France's total capacity represented a 17 percent increase over its 1995 levels and 12.74 percent of all capacity offered by all carriers between Europe and Asia last year.

MergeGlobal said Air France was the capacity leader in three market subcategories: Europe-to-North Asia (11.9 percent of total scheduled traffic), North Asia-to-Europe (11.5 percent), and Southeast Asia-to-Europe (16.1 percent).
Lufthansa was the leader in Europe-to-Southeast Asia, followed by Air France, and runner up in the other three, but in 1995 Lufthansa had led in all four Europe-Asia categories.
Lufthansa's total capacity represented 12.24 percent of total capacity and 2.54 percent more capacity than Lufthansa flew in the Europe-Asia market in 1995.

Japan Air Lines, which shared leadership of Europe-North Asia trade in 1993, has been reducing freighter capacity in the intervening years. Last year saw its share of capacity for both east and westbound Europe-Asia traffic decline for the fourth consecutive year.
Hong Kong's Cathay Pacific Airways has been third in North Asia-to-Europe capacity since 1995, but for the first time last year also overtook JAL for third place in Europe-to-North Asia traffic.
KLM Royal Dutch Airlines was third in both North Asia-to-Europe and Europe-to-North Asia.
Asian growth carriers are playing an ever increasing role in US-Asia cargo traffic, but none of the upstarts like Korea's Asiana or Taiwan's EVA Air made the top 10 in Europe-Asia capacity.

The top 10 in each of the four Europe-Asia subcategories accounted for over 70 percent of the capacity in each of those market segments, said MergeGlobal. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
